name: ViewBench
summary: 用于评测相机条件长时视频世界模型视角一致性和闭环回访一致性的数据集与诊断基准。
summaryEn: A dataset and diagnostic benchmark for view consistency and loop closure in camera-conditioned long-horizon video world models.
scale: 1,059 UE5 sequences; about 500K frames across 10 environments
scaleZh: 1,059 条 UE5 序列，约 50 万帧，覆盖 10 个环境
access: Training split available on Hugging Face and ModelScope
accessZh: 训练划分已在 Hugging Face 和 ModelScope 提供
verdict: 专门诊断视频世界模型回到旧视角时是否保持世界状态
verdictEn: Diagnoses whether video world models preserve world state when revisiting views
wmNote: 闭环相机轨迹直接测试持久空间记忆和场景一致性。
wmNoteEn: Loop-closure camera paths directly test persistent spatial memory and scene consistency.
